collection.title: Ford Transit Connect 2002 to 2013 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A 2002 to 2008 version of a Ford Transit Connect requires a 22" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 20" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook Arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Transit Connect which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
